items.settingsPath: Microsoft Store > Settings, and turn App updates back on.
items.name: Stop Store apps updating themselves
items.desc: The Microsoft Store stops downloading app updates in the background. You can still update anything by hand from the Store's Library page.
items.riskNote: App updates carry security fixes too, and nothing will remind you they are waiting. This is about a background download nobody asked for, not about staying on old versions forever - check the Library occasionally.
